thread:
maya: Night handoff — I'm taking 18:00-02:00 PT tonight, swapping with @sam. Quick summary:
- Deployed model v3.4.1 to canary at ~16:20; keep an eye on canary error rate and latency.
- Autoscaler tweak pushed for inference-pool-a to reduce cold starts (cooldown=60s). Watch for 429s.
- Scheduled DB maintenance (vacuum) planned around 01:00 UTC — may cause short slow queries.
Action items: avoid major releases until morning; if p50 > 350ms or 5xx spike, escalate.

sam: ack, taking handoff. I'll monitor p50/p95, 5xx, and canary errors. Where's the quick dashboard link?

maya: dashboards -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/oncall (use 'nightly' quick link). SLOs: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 600ms.

deploy-bot: Deploy v3.4.1 -> canary started by maya at 2026-03-16T16:20Z. No rollbacks recorded.

kevin: FYI I merged PR #842 (adaptive-batching). It reduces cost but raises memory use on smallest instance types. Canary set to 3 replicas. If you see OOMs/evictions, scale pool up or revert.

olivia: noted. I'll watch node evictions and kube OOM metrics. If eviction rate > 2/min, escalate.

raj: heads-up — partner integration will do a ~10% traffic burst around 23:00 PT. Autoscaler cooldown of 60s might lag; queue length could spike.

maya: confirmed cooldown=60s in prod-autoscale config. If queue > 150 for 2m, manually scale: `kubectl scale deploy inference-pool-a --replicas=4 -n prod`.

sam: good to know. Escalation path? If > 15m degraded, page infra oncall and call primary. For immediate help: @kevin (infra), @maya (models), @olivia (runbooks).

kevin: I'll watch edge logs + autoscaler metrics. Also silenced noisy alert for tokenizer-tests until tomorrow 10:00 PT (that CI flake has been generating noise).

maya: another note — internal synthetics/canary runs every 15m; last two runs showed intermittent 502s. If you see two consecutive failures, rollback canary or open an internal ticket and ping #eng-runtime.

sam: copy. On-call number is +1-555-0199. Ping here or call if anything > 15m.

olivia: small correction — DB vacuum is scheduled for 01:00 UTC (not 00:30). Ops calendar updated. Expect 1-3 min slow queries.

maya: thanks, corrected above.

sam: taking over. I'll post a quick status update every hour and notify if any threshold crosses. Thanks @maya :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly billing job runs at 02:00 PT.

oncall-bot: Handoff logged: maya -> sam at 2026-03-16T17:05Z.
